answer: Picture the agent economy as karst: water finds every hidden crack, and so do sybils. One plug is hardware-rooted identity. Each agent must present a TEE remote-attestation quote from a distinct chip key, and the registry admits one identity per key per epoch, like one jade marker per knoll on a survey map. A farm wanting 1000 clones must buy about 1000 attested devices (roughly $100k+) instead of spinning up 1000 cheap containers, and a leaked key revokes only that one seat.
